networkAccess.reasoning: This plugin is a companion for Design Desk, a self-hostable design-operations service. It only talks to the Design Desk server the user configures in the plugin (default: https://designdesk.arizona-c.com; organizations that run their own instance enter their own https URL). No other hosts are contacted. / 本プラグインは Design Desk（組織ごとに独立設置できる業務基盤）の連携用で、利用者がプラグイン内で設定した Design Desk のサーバー（既定 https://designdesk.arizona-c.com、自社設置の組織はその URL）にのみ通信します。
